function.description: Query the endpoints, optionally using various filter and pagination criteria. 'GET /endpoints/count' API can be used to find out the total number of endpoints matching the filter criteria.
function.name: api_queryTheEndpoints

aiSpoofingTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to AI spoofing. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

ancPolicy.description: ANC policy. Only exact match will be returned.

authMethod.description: Authentication method. Partial string is allowed.

changedProfileTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to changing profile labels. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

concurrentMacTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to concurrent MAC address. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

deviceType.description: Type of device to search for. Partial string is allowed.

hardwareManufacturer.description: Hardware manufacturer to search for. Partial string is allowed.

hardwareModel.description: Hardware model to search for. Partial string is allowed.

include.description: The datasets that should be included in the response. By default, value of this parameter is blank, and the response will include only basic details of the endpoint. To include other datasets or dictionaries, send comma separated list of following values: 'ALL' - Include all attributes. 'CDP', 'DHCP', etc. - Include attributes from given dictionaries. To get full list of dictionaries, use corresponding GET API. 'ANC' - Include ANC policy related details. 'TRUST' - Include trust score details.

ip.description: IP address to search for. Partial string is allowed.

ipBlocklistDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints hitting IP blocklist or not.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

macAddress.description: MAC address to search for. Partial string is allowed.

macAddresses.description: List of MAC addresses to filter on. Only exact matches will be returned.

natTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to NAT access. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 0

operatingSystem.description: Operating system to search for. Partial string is allowed.

order.description: Order to be used for sorting. Possible values are 'asc', 'desc'.

profilingStatus.description: Profiling status of the endpoint. Possible values are 'profiled', 'partialProfiled', 'notProfiled'.

randomMac.description: Flag to fetch endpoints having randomized MAC or not.

registered.description: Flag to fetch manually registered or non-registered endpoints.

sortBy.description: Name of the column to sort the results on. Please note that fetch might take more time if sorting is requested. Possible values are 'macAddress', 'ip'.

trustScore.description: Overall trust score of the endpoint. It can be provided either as a number value (e.g. 5), or as a range (e.g. 3-7). Provide value as '-' if you want to search for all endpoints where trust score is not assigned.

unauthPortDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints exposing unauthorized ports or not.

weakCredDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints having weak credentials or not.

hasMoreResults.description: Flag to indicate whether more results are available than what is currently in the response.

ancPolicy.description: ANC policy currently applied to the endpoint in ISE.

attributes.description: Various endpoint attributes grouped by dictionaries (e.g. IP, DHCP, etc).

deviceType.description: Type of the device represented by this endpoint.

name.description: Name of the granular ANC policy.

nasIpAddress.description: IP address of the network device where endpoint is attached.

lastProbeCollectionTimestamp.description: Last probe collection timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

randomMac.description: Flag to indicate whether MAC address is a randomized one or not.

registered.description: Flag to indicate whether this is a manually registered endpoint or not.

aiSpoofingTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to AI spoofing.

changedProfileTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to changing profile labels.

concurrentMacTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to concurrent MAC address.

ipBlocklistDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints hitting IP blocklist or not.

natTrustLevel.description: Trust level of the endpoint due to NAT access.

trustScore.description: Overall trust score of the endpoint.

unauthPortDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints exposing unauthorized ports or not.

weakCredDetected.description: Flag to fetch endpoints having weak credentials or not.

totalResults.description: Total number of records matching the given filter criteria.
